Control plane vs cell. Lyzr's control plane is global: sign-in, tenants, billing and policy authoring. Everything that touches prompts, plans, code or data runs inside a cell, so a whole cell can sit in a customer's
own cloud while only IDs, statuses, usage and health cross to Lyzr.
Cells are the unit of scale. One cell handles about 500 running sandboxes. Lyzr adds cells as load grows, and a customer's VPC or on-prem install is just another cell.

Lyzr Studio sits beside the cell. In Lyzr Cloud it's Lyzr's shared Studio, with each workspace's own account. In VPC and on-prem modes the Studio runtime and registry run inside the customer's cell, so agent traffic
